LACE'S PLAN:

In real life, the UNSC is composed of 5 permanent members + 10 rotationary members elected for 2 year terms. To model this in game, I propose the following:

  • 5 permanent members remain
  • All currently played nations who are part of the UN (51 of us including the 5 permanent members) will vote on 4 non-permanent members. Rules will be put in place for this and I will likely post this as France with mod approval.
  • Non-permanent members will serve for 5 in-game years (to account for how fast our time moves). Elections will be held every 5 in game years and no country may serve twice in a row.
